data.body: PANEL-APPROVED DEVIATION (ADR-0022 rev.3, 2026-06-04): live on PR #642 the identity exemption was found NON-FUNCTIONAL — a real bug. ROOT CAUSE: GitHub's /commits/{sha}/pulls LIST endpoint OMITS merged_by (returns the simple PR representation; merged_by=null, verified live). ADR-0022 rev.2's 'merged_by rides the list object -> zero new API calls' was FALSE; the code read null -> never exempted. The original 4-reviewer panel (incl. the accuracy lens) ASSERTED the wrong API shape, and my tests modeled the fictional shape (merged_by in the list mock) so they were green against a non-existent API. FIX (rev.3): both gates (rc_sha_is_reviewed + verify-session-provenance G3) now evaluate the review-check FIRST and, ONLY on the bypass path (review failed/not_found), fetch merged_by via GET /pulls/{number} (--jq '.merged_by.id // empty'); budget-guarded (provenance side); fail-closed on empty/null/non-numeric/call-failure. Cost: zero extra calls on the reviewed path, one per covering PR on the rare bypass path. FULL 4-REVIEWER PANEL re-run (accuracy/historical/fitness + convergence): accuracy [audit-sweep bullet carried the same false assumption -> corrected], fitness [unguarded budget increment -> GH_BUDGET-guarded], historical [LOAD-BEARING: two parallel per-path tests are NOT the 0cd7-DD6/v4-anti-divergence shared-fixture equivalence test -> built test-identity-exemption-equivalence.sh driving BOTH gates over one fixture table, asserting identical verdicts, mutation-verified 4/4]. CONVERGENCE: APPROVED. Tests: equivalence 4/4, identity 3/3, provenance-admin-exempt 4/4, provenance 35/35, coverage-invariant 13/13. TRACKED FOLLOW-UPS (not blocking this fix): (1) P-IDENTITY-EXEMPT liveness gate still unbuilt — its absence is WHY this shape bug reached #642 (a CI liveness test injecting merged_by==bypass would have caught it pre-land); land before the 3ee4 enforce-flip. (2) lib-path GitHub calls are OUTSIDE the CF-6 budget envelope (asymmetric vs provenance) — note for 7b77. LESSON: list endpoints carry only SHA-identity fields; per-resource facts need the single-GET (already documented in the squash/rebase covering-PR doctrine at verify-session-provenance.sh:~327).
